The '''1946 Midwest Conference football season''' was the season of [[college football]] played by the nine member schools of the [[Midwest Conference]] (MWC), formally known as the "Midwest Collegiate Athletic Conference", as part of the [[1946 college football season]].

The [[1946 Lawrence Vikings football team|Lawrence Vikings]], in their ninth season under head coach [[Bernie Heselton]], won the MWC championship with a 6–1–1 record (6–0 against MWC opponents). Back Carl Giordana and tackle Richard Miller received first-team honors on the 1946 All-Midwest Conference football team.

The [[1946 Ripon Redmen football team|Ripon Redmen]], led by head coach [[Carl Doehling]], finished in second place with a 4–3–1 record (3–1 against MWC teams). Ripon back Ted Scalissi and guard James Callan were selected as first-team All-MWC players.

The third-place [[1946 Cornell Purple football team|Cornell Purple]] compiled a 5–2–1 record and led all other teams with three players (end Charles Jacot, guard Joe Pelisek, and center Ralph Ringgenberg) selected to the All-MWC first team.

The '''1946 Lawrence Vikings football team''' represented Lawrence College (later renamed [[Lawrence University]]). In their ninth year under head coach [[Bernie Heselton]], the Vikings compiled a 6–1–1 record (6–0 against MWC teams), won the MCAC championship, and outscored opponents by a total of 217 to 78.<ref>{{cite book |title=The Official National Collegiate Athletic Association Football Guide including the Official Rules 1947 |publisher=A.S. Barnes and Company |year=1947 |editor=Bingham |editor-first=W. J. |page=}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Lawrence Yearly Results |publisher=College Football Data Warehouse |access-date=June 2, 2022 |url=http://www.cfbdatawarehouse.com/data/active/l/lawrence/1945-1949_yearly_results.php |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150906035433/http://www.cfbdatawarehouse.com/data/active/l/lawrence/1945-1949_yearly_results.php |archive-date=6 September 2015 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

Five Lawrence players received honors on the 1946 All-Midwest Conference football team: back Carl Giordana (first team); tackle Richard Miller (first team); tackle Kenneth Bahnson (second team); guard Bob McMaster (second); and end Bill Burton (second).<ref name=AMWC>{{cite news|title=Giordana, Miller Repeat On All-Midwest Grid Team: Three Vikes Are Named On 2nd Squad|newspaper=The Post-Crescent|date=November 22, 1946|page=13|url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/103079791/giordana-miller-repeat-on-all-midwest/|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}}</ref>

The team played its home games at Whiting Field in [[Appleton, Wisconsin]].
